    Stable bricks from integral weights outside the g-vector fan #

    Propositions 2.7 (prop:mp-witness, after Mousavand–Paquette) and 2.8 (prop:stable-witnesses) of the manuscript:

    • exists_hom_of_class_outside_fan and minimal_image_stable_at_corrected_class: any differential p representing g ∉ Σ(R) admits a nonzero morphism coker p → ker(νp), and the image B of such a morphism of minimal k-dimension is a brick stable at the corrected integral weight (dim_k B) g - ⟨g, [B]⟩ [R].
    • exists_occurrence_polynomial and exists_infinite_stable_classes_of_outside_fan: each fixed brick occurs only on a proper determinantal hypersurface, yielding infinitely many nonisomorphic bricks of one dimension vector and integral weight when k is infinite.
    • exists_equal_class_polytope_stable_pair: over every field, an E-infinite algebra admits two nonisomorphic bricks stable at a common integral weight with the same dimension vector and submodule polytope.
